units.source_text: 他将此信缚在一枝很长的荻花上，故意教人注目。

en.t: He tied this letter to a very long spray of reed blossoms, deliberately making it catch people's eye.

units.source_text: 口头上吩咐小君“偷偷地送去”，心中却想道：

en.t: Out loud he told Kogimi, "Take it secretly," but in his heart he was thinking:

units.source_text: “如果小君不小心，被藏人少将看到了，

en.t: "If Kogimi is careless and the Chamberlain Lieutenant happens to see it,

units.source_text: 他知道轩端荻最初的情人是我，就会赦免她的罪过。”

en.t: then, knowing that Nokiba no Ogi's first lover was me, he will forgive her offense."

units.source_text: 此种骄矜之心，实在讨厌！

en.t: Such conceited pride is truly unpleasant!

units.source_text: 小君于少将不在家时把信送交。

en.t: Kogimi delivered the letter when the Lieutenant was not at home.

units.source_text: 轩端荻看了，虽然恨他无情，但蒙他想念，也可感谢，

en.t: When Nokiba no Ogi read it, she resented his coldness, yet she was also grateful that he still thought of her,

units.source_text: 便以时间匆促为借口，草草地写了两句答诗，交付小君：

en.t: so, using the press of time as an excuse, she hastily wrote a brief reply poem and handed it to Kogimi:
